name: writing
description: Writing voice, comment discipline, and user-facing error text. Skills: writing-voice (docs, notes, and short messages), comment-police (default is add no comments; carve-outs are license/SPDX, lint suppressions, generated-file banners, and public-API contracts), writing-error-messages (user-facing errors in three parts: what happened, why, and next steps the user should take). Use voice for prose, comment-police when editing source, and error-messages for UI, API, or log user text.
